CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, September 18, 2024 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Laura Longoria, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE JUNE 19, 2024 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  July 17, 2024
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, June 19, 2024
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:06 P.M. on Wednesday, June 19, 2024, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Longoria and Commission Member Massaro.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Hermano.
Also attending: Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor Amanda Leonard and
Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE MAY 15, 2024 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING
With a motion from Commission Member Longoria and a second from Vice President Saunders
the May 15, 2024 minutes were approved.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
Commission Member Longoria and the Alhambra Historical Society have collaborated and are
identifying historical Alhambra events and locations that will be used as inspiration to beautify
city utility boxes. With the assistance of Vice President Saunders, a few artful wrap concepts
include the following: citrus groves, the Peacock House, Alhambra Airport, Diamond Castle,
Midwick Water Tower, Artist Road, and Captain Grey’s House.

Vice President Saunders has researched Gabrielino land acknowledgments for entrances of
Alhambra public spaces and will return to the next City Arts and Cultural Events Commission
meeting after discussing procedure with Gabrielino tribe representatives.

The Alhambra City Council requested “Alhambra Place Makers” to be displayed throughout the
city to increase connection and exposure. Director Houghton presented two sketches of
Alhambra City Hall and Granada Park entrances with a 16 width and 18 height script of
“Alhambra” made from aluminum and backlit with LED light features that will be available for
public photo opportunities. The Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission supported
the project and look forward to working together.

The Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission agreed to research uplighting for
Alhambra City Hall to show solidarity on upcoming holidays and memorials.

STAFF REPORT
 Recreation Supervisor Amanda Leonard shared event details and invited the Alhambra City Arts
and Cultural Events Commission to join the Summer Serenade and Movies in the Park events at
Alhambra Park.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
None.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Vice President Saunders and a second by Commission Member Longoria, the
June 19, 2024 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:38 P.M.
